name: assist-hero
description: Help desk hero: copy and badges beside a stage holding the employee photo, an employee request card, the assistant's reply card with its actions, floating icon tiles and a chip strip. Live: .epx-hero on /solutions/help-desk-ticketing/.

title_accent.description: Part of the title painted with the brand gradient.

features.description: Chips in the strip under the stage. Each: label; icon (URL) or icon_svg.

message.description: The request card: avatar, name, time, title, shot (screenshot URL), dept, dept_icon_svg, category.

assistant.description: The assistant reply card: orb (image), name, when, body, actions (array of {label, icon_svg}; the first is the primary button).

response.description: The follow-up card: icon_svg, title, body, link_label, link_icon_svg.

tiles.description: Up to three floating icon tiles. Each: icon_svg; optional tone (ticket, flag, history).
